title: BarkBox Alternatives: 6 Boxes Like BarkBox, Compared - Cratejoy
summary: Looking for a BarkBox alternative? Compare six dog subscription boxes by price, toy toughness, and fit, from tough chewers to treats-only and puppy plans.
body_markdown:
## The alternatives


Closest match to BarkBox


### Pooch Perks Dog Box vs BarkBox


Preferred Seller


[Pooch Perks Dog Box](https://www.cratejoy.com/products/pooch-perks) by Pooch Perks Premium Customized Dog Boxes


From $33.17 / box


Ships fast


[Shop Now](https://www.cratejoy.com/products/pooch-perks)


**Best for:** A household that wants BarkBox’s rhythm from a small seller, or two dogs of different sizes sharing one box.


The standard Pooch Box holds two treats, two or three plush toys, and a chew, on a theme that changes monthly. Pooch Perks has sold on Cratejoy since 2022, carries the Ships Fast badge, and has 53 reviews on its listing, including a five-star one from a BarkBox convert.


#### What feels familiar


The count is nearly identical to BarkBox’s classic tier, the toys are plush, the treats come from US makers, and you choose a size so a Chihuahua and a Lab don’t get the same rope.


#### What changes


The fourth size is Mixed, meant for homes with dogs of different sizes, which BarkBox doesn’t offer. Themes are the seller’s own rather than licensed characters. The $49 Pampered Pooch Box adds a third treat, a second chew, a roll of poop bags, and an accessory.


Tougher toys


### PupJoy Power Chewers Box vs BarkBox


[Monthly PupJoy Power Chewers Box, Treats & Toys, All Natural](https://www.cratejoy.com/products/pupjoy) by PupJoy


From $37.00 / box


Free shipping


[Shop Now](https://www.cratejoy.com/products/pupjoy)


**Best for:** The Super Chewer household that wants the durable-toy idea without a 6- or 12-month commitment.


This is the pick for the dog who treats plush as a two-minute project. The box comes in five sizes from Tea Cup to Huuuge, and the treats and toys are chosen against a profile you fill out at signup. PupJoy has sold on Cratejoy since 2020 and lists a Purina Pet Care Innovation Award on its page.


#### What feels familiar


It answers the same question Super Chewer does, tougher toys plus treats, and it still arrives as a monthly surprise sized to your dog.


#### What changes


There’s no term to sign and no cancellation window to wait out. PupJoy states a no-strings satisfaction guarantee, ships to Canada for $5, and supports shelter animals through its Helping Paws program with the Bissell Pet Foundation.


Costs less


### Ziva’s Surprise Pack vs BarkBox


[Ziva's Surprise Pack for Multiple Dog Homes](https://www.cratejoy.com/products/zivas-surprise-pack-for-multiple-dog-homes-zivassurprisepack) by Ziva's Surprise Pack


From $22.50 / box


Free shipping


[Shop Now](https://www.cratejoy.com/products/zivas-surprise-pack-for-multiple-dog-homes-zivassurprisepack)


**Best for:** Multi-dog homes and treat-motivated dogs whose people want to spend less than BarkBox.


Plenty of dogs have a toy basket that’s already full and a treat jar that never is. Ziva’s Surprise Pack drops the toys and sends two bags of treats a month from Scout & Zoe’s, the seller’s sister company. The seller describes the treats as made in the US from human-grade ingredients, with no wheat, corn, soy, or preservatives.


#### What feels familiar


The treats are the part of BarkBox most dogs have an opinion about, and here they arrive in full-size bags on the same monthly cadence.


#### What changes


No toys and no chew, so this adds to a toy habit rather than replacing one. If the squeak is your dog’s favorite part of the month, look at Pooch Perks or PupJoy instead. Order by the 14th to catch the current month’s box.


More than toys and treats


### Papa Pupsie’s Snax N Treats vs BarkBox


[Papa Pupsie's Snax N Treats Pup Box](https://www.cratejoy.com/products/papa-pupsie-snax-n-stuff-dog-box-alchepharma) by AlchePharma


From $39.58 / box


[Shop Now](https://www.cratejoy.com/products/papa-pupsie-snax-n-stuff-dog-box-alchepharma)


**Best for:** The owner who’d rather the monthly box replace a store trip than add to the toy pile.


BarkBox is a toy box with treats in it — this one is closer to a monthly supply run. AlchePharma’s standing list for the box covers treats, toys, bones, grooming gear, and walking tools, leaning toward healthy and eco-friendly picks, and the seller values the contents at $65 or more. The box is named for Papa Pupsie, the first dog in the seller’s foster home.


#### What feels familiar


Treats and a toy still show up every month, and the first box ships within three business days of your order rather than on a fixed calendar.


#### What changes


The mix is wider and more practical: a bone, a grooming item, something for the walk. Expect things you’d otherwise pick up at the pet store alongside the toys.


Something for you too


### Pup and Pawrent Box vs BarkBox


25% off


[Pup and Pawrent Box](https://www.cratejoy.com/products/pup-and-pawrent-box-normiesboutique) by Normie's Boutique


From $44.00 / box


[Shop Now](https://www.cratejoy.com/products/pup-and-pawrent-box-normiesboutique)


**Best for:** Someone who wants the dog’s box to come with a small gift for the human who opens it.


Normie’s Boutique splits the box down the middle. Each month brings five to seven items on one theme: one or two toys, one or two treats, and a handmade bow or bandana for the dog, then two or three things for the person, a tote, a tee, a mug, a scrunchie, a candle. You can email to swap any item, and the shop gives to local animal shelters.


#### What feels familiar


A themed monthly reveal with toys and treats at the center of it.


#### What changes


Roughly half the box is for you, so the dog’s share is smaller than a BarkBox and the price is higher. Matching accessories, a bandana for the dog and a scrunchie or tee for you, are the point.


A puppy that’s still growing


### PupBox vs BarkBox


**Best for:** A new puppy in a one-dog home, especially with a first-time owner who’d use the training guides.


BarkBox sends the same kind of box to a four-month-old and a four-year-old.[PupBox](https://www.pupbox.com/) doesn’t. You build a profile with the pup’s birthday, expected adult size, and any dietary restrictions, and the box changes as the dog does: teething chews and cuddly plush in the puppy months, tougher toys and brain games in the young-pup stage, health and wellness picks once the dog is grown. Every box carries five to seven items and a training guide for that stage. PupBox isn’t sold on Cratejoy, so the link goes to the brand’s own site.


#### What feels familiar


Toys, treats, and chews on a monthly cadence, sized to the dog, from a brand with a size chart and a plan ladder that looks a lot like BARK’s.


#### What changes


The stage system comes with commitments of its own. Plans auto-renew for the same length you chose, prepaid terms aren’t refunded if you cancel, and it offers no two-pup option and no grain-free treats. PupBox says it will replace any item you don’t love.
